title: Exploratory analysis of tumor budding density in resected synchronous and metachronous colorectal liver metastases.
caption: Kaplan–Meier curves for 5-year overall survival according to tumor budding density in patients with metachronous CRLM.
context: Kaplan–Meier curves for 5-year overall survival according to tumor budding density in patients with metachronous CRLM. Figure 2 showed no statistically significant difference in 5-year overall survival between patients with metachronous colorectal liver metastases according to tumor budding density (log-rank p = 0.327).
